title: Existing and proposed site plan
goal: A planning reviewer can distinguish retained, proposed and demolished work while understanding the revised vehicle access and site dimensions.

rubric.must: The parcel boundary and Industrial Avenue frontage are clearly visible as distinct site features.
The retained warehouse, proposed extension and demolished outbuilding use visibly different line or fill treatments.
The removed existing access and the proposed vehicle access are visibly distinguishable and labelled.
The proposed extension visibly adjoins the retained warehouse without obscuring either footprint.
The frontage, parcel-depth and extension dimensions are readable and associated with their measured edges.
A north arrow and scale bar are visible on the plan.
Callouts, setbacks and labels remain legible without covering the building footprints or access routes.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 clearly depicts the required industrial parcel and uses distinct building treatments, labelled access changes and relevant dimensions, whereas Image 2 depicts a residential site and omits Industrial Avenue and the extension dimension.
